source.build_pattern: Path-B ritual skill — David Allen's three-phase weekly-review loop preserved + deterministic scanner/gate/auditor scripts added
source.distinct_from: productivity/reflect (per-conversation reflection on one piece of work, not a recurring cadence over a whole system); productivity/capture (brain-dump intake that feeds the system, not the periodic review that maintains it); project-management sprint retrospectives (a team ceremony about a shared iteration, not a personal trusted-system audit)
